newsitem.title: USA: Ross Stores sets 2-for-1 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Ross Stores sets 2-for-1 stock split.

text.p: Ross Stores Inc Thursday set a two-for-one stock split to be effected in the form of a 100 percent stock dividend.
The company said the dividend will be paid on or about March 5, to stockholders of record as of February 11.

The company said the board of directors also approved an extension of the company's existing stock repurchase program by authorizing the buyback of an additional 1.5 million shares three million shares post-split, or approximately six percent of the company's currently outstanding common stock.

This repurchase will be effected from time to time through open market and privately arranged transactions. The company recently completed the two million share repurchase program authorized in fiscal 1996 for a total of five million shares repurchased since 1993.
